question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation can be attained together
Great accomplishment arises from such attainment
Yoginis favor one possessing this accomplishment
inference: One who attains great accomplishment in both enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: One may become dear to the yoginis through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
